snippet.title: Vishal Dadlani’s ‘All Religions Are Equal’ Claim DEBUNKED? #shorts
snippet.description:
Vishal Dadlani’s ‘All Religions Are Equal’ Claim DEBUNKED? #shorts 

Vishal Dadlani recently made an interesting remark about spirituality, claiming that he has explored different religions and believes that their essence is ultimately the same. But is that really true?

In this video, we examine Vishal Dadlani’s comments and question the popular idea that all religions teach the same things. From the concept of being a good Christian or a good Muslim to the historical record of religious conquests and the Crusades, we explore the differences between religious philosophies and their historical impact.

We also look at the central idea of Sanatan Dharma — “सर्वे भवन्तु सुखिनः सर्वे सन्तु निरामयाः” — a prayer for the well-being and happiness of all.

Is it fair to reduce every religious tradition to the same set of beliefs? And does the philosophy of Sanatan Dharma offer a fundamentally different approach to the welfare of the world?

Watch the video and join the discussion.

snippet.description:

🔑 영상에 담지 못한 것

▸ 첫 대회(2024년) 팀은 누구였을까요?
코치 이태곤 원사, 사수 박대운 상사, 관측수 임기현 중사, 통역 장필성 상사 넷이었습니다. 박 상사는 첫해엔 사수, 이듬해엔 관측수로 나갔습니다.

▸ 저격총 소음기는 왜 달까요?
박 상사의 말로는 소리보다 총구 불꽃을 줄이는 것이 먼저라고 합니다. 열상 장비에 자리가 잡히지 않게 하려는 것이죠.

▸ 위장복(길리 슈트)은 다 만들어 갈까요?
30~40%만 달아 가고, 나머지는 현장의 풀과 나뭇가지로 채운다고 합니다.

▸ 경기 전에는 무엇을 할까요?
조준경과 거리측정기를 많을 땐 스무 번까지 확인한다고 합니다. 「장비 고장도 실력」이라서요.

▸ 그 뒤 국내 국제 대회에서는?
2026년 6월 포항에서 열린 국제 저격수 경연대회(38팀, 미국·필리핀·태국 참가)에서 육군 701특공연대가 1위, 미 해병대가 2위를 했습니다.

snippet.title: I hope Megan gets some rest🥺#megan#katseye#concussion#shortsfeed#heartmonitor#katseyeconcert
snippet.description:
Megan Skiendiel’s health has become a major topic of discussion among KATSEYE fans, especially following her reported concussion and the recent appearance of what looks like a heart-rate monitoring device during the group’s performances.

Megan previously informed fans that she had suffered a concussion and that medical professionals had advised her to take time to recover. This led to the postponement of several KATSEYE tour dates, leaving EYEKONS concerned about her well-being.

Following her return to the stage, fans noticed significant changes in her performances. Megan appeared wearing sunglasses, performed with reduced choreography and spent portions of the show seated. These adjustments raised questions about whether she was fully ready to resume touring.

However, the discussion intensified when fans spotted what appeared to be a heart-rate monitor attached around Megan’s waist during the Dallas concert. The device quickly became a talking point across social media, with fans questioning why she appeared to be wearing monitoring equipment while performing. Although its exact purpose has not been officially confirmed, its appearance has added another layer of concern surrounding her recovery.

A heart-rate monitor is generally used to track heart activity, but seeing such a device does not automatically mean someone has a heart condition. There has been no confirmed public diagnosis of a heart-related condition involving Megan.

Many fans are now asking HYBE and Geffen Records to prioritise her health and ensure that she receives appropriate medical attention, adequate recovery time and the necessary support throughout the tour.

Megan’s dedication to KATSEYE and her fans is evident, but her health should always come before choreography, concerts or tour schedules. EYEKONS want to see all six members performing together, but above all, they want Megan to recover completely and safely.

Wishing Megan a healthy and complete recovery. Her well-being matters more than any performance.

Hello And Welcome to CricTalks!

PREVIEW: The format of 50-over cricket now takes centre stage in India's tour of New Zealand 2026, as India and New Zealand prepare to compete in a five-match ODI series, starting on Wednesday, November 4, with the first ODI at Eden Park in Auckland. After an exciting T20I series that India won 3-2, attention now shifts to the longer white-ball format and another important overseas challenge.

India enter the ODI series looking to build strong momentum away from home and sharpen their 50-over structure ahead of the 2027 World Cup. With Shubman Gill leading the side and experienced names like Rohit Sharma, Virat Kohli and Shreyas Iyer in the squad, India will look to combine experience with fresh energy. The ODI format gives India a chance to focus on longer batting phases, middle-over control, and sharper death-over execution. With Jasprit Bumrah rested and Prasidh Krishna unavailable through injury, squad balance, finishing options, and bowling combinations will be key areas to watch as India aim to establish early control.

New Zealand, meanwhile, begin the ODI series at home with a major opportunity to challenge India and make a statement in the 50-over format. Led by Mitchell Santner, the hosts will look to build on their two consecutive T20I victories, maintain batting consistency, strengthen middle-over discipline, and use their pace and all-round options intelligently. snippet.title: This Beetle's Babies Have a Genius Way to Find a Nest 😱 #animals
snippet.description:
What if a tiny insect could smell just like a flower?

Meet the Oil Beetle (Meloe proscarabaeus), a fascinating parasitic beetle with one of the strangest life cycles in the insect world.

Its tiny first-stage larvae, called Triungulins, gather together on plants and produce a scent that closely resembles the smell of real flowers. This tricks passing Bees into approaching them. Once a Bee gets close, the larvae grab onto its body and hitch a ride back to its nest.

But their journey doesn't end there. They must reach a suitable solitary Bee's nest, where they eventually feed on the Bee's egg and the food stored for its offspring.

A 2026 scientific study published in PNAS revealed that these larvae produce 17 different floral-scent monoterpenoids to attract Bees.

This is one of the most fascinating examples of chemical mimicry found in insects.

Watch until the end to discover how this tiny parasite begins its extraordinary transformation.

Scientific Name: Meloe proscarabaeus  
Common Name: European Black Oil Beetle

snippet.description:
2024년 9월, 피터 틸은 "관심은 어느 순간 세상에서 가장 나쁜 것이 된다"고 말했습니다. 2년 뒤인 2026년 11월 12일, 젠슨황이 엔비디아를 떠났습니다.

그 주에 돈을 굴리는 사람들이 본 숫자는 2,790억 달러. 엔비디아가 부품 회사들에게 "앞으로 이만큼 사겠다"고 약속해 둔 돈이고, 주로 메모리입니다(엔비디아 분기 보고서).
이 영상은 젠슨황이 돈을 어디에, 어떤 순서로 넣었는지를 본인과 주변 사람들의 원래 발언으로 따라갑니다.

- 부품 회사로 먼저 가는 돈: "선지급도 하고, 설비 증설 자금까지 댄다"(젠슨황) / 계약 1년→5년, 선급금 100억 달러 단위
- 그 대가: "생산능력 60~70%를 시장가보다 싸게"(분석가) vs "가격을 고정하는 건 원치 않는다"(최태원 회장)
- 시계: "칩 7개, 테이프아웃 일정은 하나, 모두가 맞춘다"(젠슨황)
